methodologyNotes: Covers passive floorstanding (tower) home hi-fi loudspeakers sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes bookshelf/standmount, in-wall, portable, and active/powered speakers with built-in amplification. Price is typical US MSRP per single speaker in USD (note pair pricing in priceNote when the manufacturer lists per pair). wayConfiguration is the crossover way count as an enum ('2-way', '2.5-way', '3-way', '4-way'). wooferSizeIn is the nominal bass/mid-bass driver diameter in inches, given as 'count x size' when multiple identical woofers are fitted (e.g. '2 x 8'). tweeterType is a design enum ('aluminium-dome', 'soft-dome', 'beryllium-dome', 'horn-loaded', 'amt', 'coaxial'). frequencyResponseHz is the manufacturer-quoted low-to-high range in Hz (e.g. '35-25000'), typically at +/-3dB. sensitivityDb is sensitivity in dB at 2.83V/1m. nominalImpedanceOhms is nominal impedance in ohms. crossoverFrequencyHz lists the crossover point(s) in Hz. recommendedPowerWatts is the manufacturer's recommended amplifier power range in watts. enclosureType is the cabinet loading enum ('bass-reflex', 'sealed', 'transmission-line', 'horn-loaded'). heightIn is cabinet height in inches excluding spikes/plinth. weightLbs is weight per speaker in pounds.
